title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Amendment Act 2013

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Amendment Act 2013
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

AN
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities (Amendment) Act, 2013
AN
ACT
further to amend the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012.
Preamble. WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa Universities Act, 2012
(Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. X of 2012), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.- (1) This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Universities (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
